items.title: Clay raises $115M Series D at a $7.1B valuation
items.note: Wellington-led round more than doubles the AI go-to-market platform's value in a year, now 17,000 clients

items.title: Lightfield raises $47M Series A to build an AI-native CRM
items.note: a16z-led round backs the Tome founders' pivot to an agent-ready Salesforce alternative, now at 5,000 customers

items.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent for everyday tasks
items.note: free tier plus $20 and $100 monthly plans, runs on its own dedicated secure cloud computer

items.title: Crusoe raises $3B at a $30B valuation to build AI data centers
items.note: valuation triples in ten months as Atreides and Valor co-lead, following its $13B Jane Street GPU deal

items.title: Mortgage applications fall again as rates hit 6.85%
items.note: MBA's weekly survey shows a 2.7% drop and refis down 6% with rates near a 13-month high

items.title: New listings keep outpacing pending sales nationally
items.note: just 95 new pendings for every 100 new listings as sellers cut prices faster than buyers respond

items.title: Upwind raises $300M, valuation more than doubles to $3.8B in five months
items.note: Bessemer and TCV lead the round for the Israeli runtime cloud-security startup, up from a $1.5B Series B in January

items.title: Israeli drone maker XTEND begins trading on the NYSE after $1.5B merger
items.note: all-stock deal with JFB Construction Holdings lists the combined XTEND AI Robotics as XTND
